intent: Design a serum-bottle execution route that does not require Agent Image Lab or Codex to read, construct, print, or store VCPToolBox admin auth secret material.

current_secret_bearing_dependency.why_admin_auth_is_required_now: The current serum VCPToolBox route owner runtime targets the VCPToolBox admin execute route, and that route currently requires a Basic Authorization header before the route HTTP request can be sent.
why_agent_image_lab_header_construction_: It makes Agent Image Lab or Codex responsible for touching secret-bearing admin auth inputs.
It creates a Red Lane secret boundary before every live route attempt.
It couples image execution readiness to local process environment state instead of VCPToolBox-owned authorization.
It increases audit burden because header construction must be proven not to print or store secret values.

candidate_routes.name: VCPToolBox internal authorized execution interface
candidate_routes.summary: VCPToolBox exposes or owns a narrow serum-bottle execution surface where authorization is resolved inside VCPToolBox, while Agent Image Lab submits only a non-secret task payload and receives a receipt reference.
candidate_routes.receipt_strategy: Agent Image Lab records a future receipt with the non-secret payload hash, selected plugin id, max call counts, VCPToolBox execution receipt id, artifact refs if any, and all side-effect flags.
candidate_routes.rollback_cleanup: Revert only the exact VCPToolBox interface change and any Agent Image Lab adapter/preflight files created under a future authorization; no current runtime side effect exists from this design package.
stop_conditions: VCPToolBox interface scope is broader than serum-bottle one-image execution
Agent Image Lab must read or construct admin auth
provider/plugin/API/image budget is not exactly one/one/one/one
receipt path or rollback plan is missing
external repo modification lacks exact authorization
validator_can_prove: This design selects a route that does not require Agent Image Lab secret contact.
This design keeps current execution flags false.
This design requires exact future authorization before VCPToolBox changes.
validator_cannot_prove: That future VCPToolBox authorization or implementation is safe.
That a future provider/plugin/API/image call will succeed.

candidate_routes.name: Local controlled bridge holds authorization context
candidate_routes.summary: A separate controlled bridge owns the admin auth context and Agent Image Lab sends only a non-secret task payload to that bridge.
candidate_routes.receipt_strategy: Receipt records bridge identity, non-secret payload hash, VCPToolBox receipt id if available, and all side-effect flags.
candidate_routes.rollback_cleanup: Stop and remove the bridge configuration or adapter created under a future exact authorization; no current bridge is created by this design package.
stop_conditions: Bridge implementation stores or prints secret material in Agent Image Lab
Bridge accepts broad or unscoped execution payloads
Bridge lifecycle or owner is unclear
validator_can_prove: This design keeps Agent Image Lab secret contact false.
This design does not create or run a bridge.
validator_cannot_prove: That a future bridge can be securely operated.
That bridge-held authorization is safer than VCPToolBox-owned authorization.

candidate_routes.name: One-time task handle or opaque execution token
candidate_routes.summary: A future VCPToolBox-owned issuer creates a one-time serum-bottle task handle that Agent Image Lab can redeem without seeing admin auth material.
candidate_routes.receipt_strategy: Receipt records non-secret handle metadata, issue/redeem timestamps, one-time consumption status, payload hash, and VCPToolBox execution receipt id.
candidate_routes.rollback_cleanup: Invalidate the one-time handle issuer or revoke unconsumed handles under VCPToolBox control; no handle is issued by this design package.
stop_conditions: Opaque handle behaves as a broad bearer secret
Handle is not bound to serum-bottle scope and one-image budget
validator_can_prove: This design requires a one-time bounded handle if Option C is chosen later.
This design does not issue or redeem a handle now.
validator_cannot_prove: That future handle semantics are non-secret.
That VCPToolBox can enforce one-time consumption.

candidate_routes.name: Current admin route fallback
candidate_routes.summary: Keep the current route owner runtime that constructs the VCPToolBox admin Authorization header from local admin auth environment inputs.
candidate_routes.receipt_strategy: Receipt remains the existing failed-closed/live-probe receipt model with explicit secret-value-read flags.
candidate_routes.rollback_cleanup: No design rollback needed; continue to keep live probe blocked unless a new exact activation and admin auth readiness true are both present.
stop_conditions: Agent Image Lab secret access is not exactly authorized
validator_can_prove: This fallback keeps the current blocker visible.
validator_cannot_prove: That current admin auth can be provided safely.
That a future route execution would pass.

preferred_route.name: VCPToolBox internal authorized execution interface
preferred_route.reason: This keeps authorization ownership inside VCPToolBox, lets Agent Image Lab submit only a non-secret task payload, avoids introducing a separate secret-holding bridge, and avoids treating an opaque bearer handle as a new secret surface.
preferred_route.future_authorization_scope: exact VCPToolBox change only; no external modification is authorized by this design package

can_prove: design package exists and has the expected schema
preferred route does not require Agent Image Lab secret contact
all current execution/live/provider/plugin/API/image flags are false
current admin auth env values were not read by this design stage
known serum-bottle receipt and artifact refs still exist
future external VCPToolBox modification requires exact authorization
package.json and validation_manifest register the validator
cannot_prove: VCPToolBox has implemented the preferred interface
future external repository changes are approved
future runtime behavior without a live probe

conclusion.preferred_route: Option A - VCPToolBox internal authorized execution interface
conclusion.next_safe_action: review this design package; if accepted, draft a future exact VCPToolBox authorization package for Option A
